summary: Sets out the requirements that individual Parallel NFS layout types must meet to work within the pNFS framework from RFC 5661. It separates the requirements for pNFS as a whole from those that apply only to the file layout, which had been blurred together.

eli5.summary: Many kinds of storage can plug into one system, but each needs to follow the same rules. This writes those rules down clearly.

questions: what must a new pnfs layout do
